description.value: European Deli & Catering Co is a specialty European food shop on Fraser Highway in Langley offering Dutch and other European products including charcuterie, cheeses, breads, and imported candy. Customer feedback highlights friendly staff and delicious sandwiches and deli meats. It would make a distinctive food stop for touring cyclists seeking something beyond standard convenience-store fare.
